title: FREE REQUEST Resident Evil: Forgotten Hero | Pixel Artist to make Creatures

posts.author: nerdfusao
posts.body:
I'm looking for a pixel artist to create 4 top-down monsters for RPG Maker VX Ace. I need the artist to have a style similar to
Enygma Vexed
in the
Horror Pop!
pack, with a
2-pixel outline
.
What I need:
2 Hunter models
: Alpha and Gamma (
64x64
)
1 B.O.W.
, a predecessor to Nemesis that resembles a Tyrant (
48x64
)
1 large deformed monster
, an evolved form of the B.O.W. (
128x128
)
Project:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/resident-evil-forgotten-hero.174769/
Let me know if you're interested!
